description: Renewable Energy Integration Model for Nigerian Power System is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Abayomi Ebenezer Olawumi (Yokohama National University). This is a spatiotemporal optimization model which uses linear programming to minimizes the overall power cost of integrating Renewable Energy to Nigerian power grid. The model was developed using Xpress-mosel, a high-level modeling and programming language designed for mathematical optimization, a part of FICO Xpress Optimization Suite. Coverage: national (NG); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
